question: What is the full form of IADP?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Intensive Agricultural District Programme__**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****The Intensive Agricultural District Programme (IADP)**:

 
• It was the first major experiment in India's agricultural sector towards increasing agricultural production after Indian independence. It was introduced in 1960 in the wake of the success of community development programmes which aimed to increase the income and improve the standard of living of farmers.
 
• **Objectives**: The primary objective of the IADP was to increase overall agricultural production in a sustainable manner, while also increasing the incomes of farmers.
 
• **Select Districts**: The programme was introduced in selected districts with the most potential for agricultural development. Initially, it was launched in seven districts: West Godavari (Andhra Pradesh), Thanjavur (Tamil Nadu), Ludhiana (Punjab), Pali (Rajasthan), Aligarh (Uttar Pradesh), Ganjam (Odisha) and Raipur (Madhya Pradesh).
